claim: ADR 0272 (lane sig, C14 / A-003): the waiter and table '#1 of N' (waiter.avg_check.peer_rank, table.avg_check.peer_rank) are pushed only when engine/comparisons.ts leaderTest calls the leader separable: groups under MIN_RANK_N = 30 checks are not ranked; a one-sided Welch test of the leader against the runner-up must reject at SIGNIFICANCE_ALPHA = 0.05 (the tie check), and one against the pooled rest must reject after its p is multiplied by the number of eligible groups (Bonferroni). A waiter's lead must also survive the table-adjusted fit (another eligible server on top there withholds it), and the untested 'actually adds the most per check' clause is gone. The table/attribute correlation needs Fisher's z, Bonferroni over the attributes tested, as well as |r| >= 0.35. Specs: insight-rankings-significance.spec.ts (null houses silent, a planted server named) and association-comparisons.spec.ts.
